name: Shay Boloor

ticker_notes.AXON: AI或令每警員月營收由約350美元增至約550美元

zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay認為$AXON被忽略的一點是AI可令每名警員每月營收提升約60%，由約350美元增至約550美元，而龐大的用戶基礎令公司可把AI直接賣進警方已在使用的工作流程。（附圖未查看）
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay thinks an overlooked part of $AXON is that AI could lift monthly revenue per officer by about 60%, from about $350 to $550, and its large installed base lets it sell AI into workflows police already use. (Attached image not reviewed.)
text:
I think one of the most overlooked parts of $AXON is that AI could increase monthly revenue per officer by ~60% from ~$350 to ~$550.

And that's where its massive installed base becomes so valuable because Axon can sell AI into workflows police departments already use rather than having to convince them to adopt something entirely new.
